description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the number of activated parameters (expressed as a percentage) and the evaluation performance measured by PPL (Perplexity) for different model configurations. The x-axis, labeled "Activated Parameters Ratio (%)", is scaled linearly from 100 to 25, with tick marks at intervals of 25. The y-axis, labeled "Eval PPL", is also linear and ranges from 11.5 to 14.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.5. The plot compares four models: "Transformer" (dashed red line), "Only MoHD FFN" (solid gray line), "Only MoHD ATTN" (solid dark blue line), and "MoHD ATTN + MLP" (solid cyan line). The "Transformer" model shows a nearly flat performance, with a PPL value of approximately 11.6 across all parameter ratios. The "Only MoHD FFN" model starts at a PPL of about 11.6 at 100% activation, decreases to a minimum of approximately 11.4 at 50% activation, and then increases to about 11.6 at 25% activation. The "Only MoHD ATTN" model begins at a PPL of approximately 11.6 at 100% activation, rises to about 12.1 at 50% activation, and then sharply increases to a PPL of 14.1 at 25% activation. The "MoHD ATTN + MLP" model starts at a PPL of about 11.6 at 100% activation, increases to approximately 12.0 at 75% activation, and then continues to rise to a PPL of about 13.1 at 25% activation.
